The floor manager on bedding supplies
Everyone on the desk should know what the desk expects
Desk conduct for companion animal travel

This section sets the baseline for daily service on the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. It directs staff to handle each case with steady judgment, clear records, and calm support for travelers and animals alike.

Staff must keep the counter orderly, speak in a controlled tone, and give each traveler accurate next steps without delay or speculation. When an animal is present, handlers must use calm, humane methods and avoid sudden movements, loud handling, or any action that could increase stress. If a crate, carrier, leash, or bedding item appears unsuitable, the desk must pause the process and arrange review before travel is confirmed. Clean surfaces, secure placement, and prompt attention to spills or waste are expected at all times.

The desk must gather travel details carefully and confirm that the animal's needs are understood before any transfer of responsibility begins. A welfare coordinator reviews animal comfort needs when a case calls for extra attention, and staff must pass along observations promptly and in full. If a traveler appears uncertain, staff should explain the available options in plain language and keep the discussion focused on welfare, safety, and compliance with carrier rules. Records must be complete, legible, and aligned with the service file for the journey.

Staff should treat every concern as actionable. If an animal shows signs of distress, the desk must notify the appropriate colleague, slow the process, and seek a humane solution without unnecessary handling. When a traveler arrives with more than one animal, each animal must be assessed on its own merits, with no assumption that the same arrangement will suit all cases. The desk is not to promise acceptance until the welfare review and operational checks are finished.

If a question falls outside desk authority, staff must refer it without delay to the welfare coordinator or the senior coordinator on duty. Companion Animal Travel Desk
